scope: Static review only of the frozen RMSCoschedule.swift, RMSCoscheduleSetup.swift, component main.swift and pure tests as pasted. No build, test, worktree or tool claims are made.
findings: Setup-only path never calls RMSCoschedule.run, RMSCoschedule.encode, RMSCoschedule.submit or any makeCommandBuffer/commit; RMSCoscheduleSetup.make contains no encoder or command buffer; zero command buffers are encoded or committed in --setup-only.

No FP64, bit-identity, guard, timing or evidence gate runs in --setup-only; the setup report hard-codes correctnessEvaluated/timingEvaluated/integrationEvidenceThresholdMet false and commandBuffersCommitted 0 under private(set), re-forced by withDiagnosticContract at encode.

All five claims (fullModelQualified, gainQualified, installable, productionPerformanceClaim, busyTimeClaim) are private(set) false in both report types and re-forced by withDiagnosticContract inside encodeReport/encodeSetupReport, so they are false at every serialization.
END is printed only after RMSCoscheduleSetup.make has returned or thrown (terminal CPU setup); a hung setup never prints END; in --setup-only no NOT_ENDED path exists because nothing is committed.

Compile/pipeline failure is captured as Result.failure, reported as compileError in the setup report and forces setupCompleted false; make emits a failed line but still emits context-ready, so stagesReached can end in context-ready while missing library-compile/pipeline-create. The current last-element check relies on the separate compileError guard; exact complete-stage equality (patched below) closes that dependency.

Report path is opened O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL 0o600 before READY; EOF or any non-GO line exits 1 via fail() before any GGUF read or Metal device creation. An empty exclusive report file remains on pre-GO failure; not a correctness defect but noted for validation.
modelSha256 is passed through from the option and validated as lowercase hex64; nothing hashes the model. Gemma4Runner.executableDigest hashes only the executable.

Untimed arm markers emit 'terminal ' + String(s.terminal); on the 10 s timeout submit returns terminal false, report.terminal becomes false, main prints NOT_ENDED and exits 5; no terminal claim on timeout.
All run-path emits are CPU-side at stage boundaries outside encoders; no emit occurs between makeComputeCommandEncoder and endEncoding; nothing is emitted per warm/timed arm.

Normal path kernel ABI, FP64 oracle, 1e-4 contract, bit identity, 256-byte canary, 2 warmup + 6 timed pairs, 0.85 evidence rule, status precedence and exit codes are present as described; no change to them is proposed.
Cosmetic only, no patch: the ternary in armFailure assignment yields the same string on both branches.
setupEmit in main.swift indexes split(...)[0]; unreachable crash for an empty done-line remainder from make, but the parse is untestable in main.swift; patched into a pure function below.
RMSCoscheduleContext has no public initializer, so a setupCompleted-true case cannot be constructed in the pure tests; the patched pure stagesComplete function is the testable surface.

requiredPatches.reason: Make the complete-ordered-stage check and the done-line parse pure, public and testable; exact equality rejects missing, duplicated, reordered or extra stages instead of only inspecting the last element.

requiredPatches.old:
r.setupCompleted = context != nil && setupError == nil && r.compileError == nil
            && stagesReached.last == RMSCoscheduleSetup.stages.last
requiredPatches.new:
r.setupCompleted = context != nil && setupError == nil && r.compileError == nil
            && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(stagesReached)
requiredPatches.reason: setupCompleted must require every ordered setup boundary, not just the final context-ready line, which make emits even after a pipeline failure.
Use the tested pure parser; removes the unguarded [0] index and keeps the CLI stage list derivation identical to what the pure tests cover.

requiredPatches.old:
t.check("setup stage list ends at context-ready", RMSCoscheduleSetup.stages.last == "context-ready"
        && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stages.count == 9)
requiredPatches.new:
t.check("setup stage list ends at context-ready", RMSCoscheduleSetup.stages.last == "context-ready"
        && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stages.count == 9)
let allStages = RMSCoscheduleSetup.stages
t.check("stagesComplete accepts the exact ordered list", RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(allStages))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects last-only", !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(["context-ready"]))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects missing compile stage",
        !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(allStages.filter { $0 != "library-compile" }))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects missing pipeline stage",
        !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(allStages.filter { $0 != "pipeline-create" }))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects reorder", !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(Array(allStages.reversed())))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects duplicate", !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(allStages + ["context-ready"]))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects extra", !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete(allStages + ["run"]))
t.check("stagesComplete rejects empty", !RMSCoscheduleSetup.stagesComplete([]))
let doneP = RMSCoscheduleSetup.donePrefix
t.check("stage name parsed from done lines only",
        RMSCoscheduleSetup.stageName(fromDoneLine: doneP + "norm-packing (3 small norm tensors, 12345 bytes)")
            == "norm-packing"
            && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stageName(fromDoneLine: doneP + "context-ready") == "context-ready"
            && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stageName(fromDoneLine: RMSCoscheduleSetup.beginPrefix + "config") == nil
            && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stageName(fromDoneLine: RMSCoscheduleSetup.failedPrefix + "weight-buffer") == nil
            && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stageName(fromDoneLine: doneP) == nil
            && RMSCoscheduleSetup.stageName(fromDoneLine: doneP + " ") == nil)
let fullNoContext = RMSCoschedule.setupDiagnostic(context: nil, setupError: nil, stagesReached: allStages,
                                                  modelSha256: sha, executableDigest: sha)
t.check("complete stages without context is not completed",
        !fullNoContext.setupCompleted && fullNoContext.stagesReached == allStages && fullNoContext.compileError == nil)
let lastOnlyWithError = RMSCoschedule.setupDiagnostic(context: nil, setupError: nil,
                                                      stagesReached: ["context-ready"], modelSha256: sha,
                                                      executableDigest: sha)
t.check("last-only stages is not completed", !lastOnlyWithError.setupCompleted)
requiredPatches.reason: Meaningful tests for exact complete-stage equality and the done-line parser; the setupCompleted-true path cannot be constructed in pure tests because RMSCoscheduleContext has no public initializer, so the pure predicate is the tested surface.

validationRequirements: Build LeviathanCore and both tools after applying the four patches; the Setup file patch must land before the RMSCoschedule.swift and main.swift patches compile.
Run tools/rms_coschedule_pure_tests and require 0 failures; the new stagesComplete, stageName and setupDiagnostic checks must all pass.
Static grep: in the --setup-only branch of main.swift and in RMSCoscheduleSetup.swift confirm no makeCommandBuffer, makeComputeCommandEncoder, commit, waitUntilCompleted or RMSCoschedule.run call.

Live --setup-only run with a real GGUF after sending exactly GO: expect 9 'setup stage done:' lines in the frozen order, the summary line 'stages reached 9 of 9', END, exit 0, and a report whose stagesReached equals the full ordered list, setupCompleted true, compileError null, commandBuffersCommitted 0 and all claim/evaluation flags false. Must finish without the 600 s SIGTERM; if it does not, locate the hang from the last begin line and draw no numeric or performance conclusion.

Pre-GO EOF run (close stdin after READY): expect exit 1, no setup stage lines, no END, no Metal device or GGUF access; note that an empty exclusive 0o600 report file remains and decide whether the harness treats that as acceptable.
Existing report path run: expect 'report path must be new' and exit 1 before READY.
Run with a non-GO line (e.g. 'go' or 'GO '): expect exit 1 before setup.
Confirm the written setup report is under 16 MiB and parses as JSON with kind rms-independent-coschedule-setup-diagnostic-v1 and modelSha256 equal to the supplied cached value verbatim.
Confirm no change to the normal run path semantics: diff after patch touches only setupDiagnostic's completion predicate, the Setup helpers, setupEmit and tests.
